mar-academic-writing 1.0.0

- Initial release with comprehensive guidelines for academic writing outputs.
- Enforces Markdown-only formatting wrapped in <ama-doc></ama-doc> tags.
- Requires strict use of academic sources with numbered, verifiable citations and a standardized References section.
- Specifies language consistency and prohibits fabrication of data or sources.
- Details structure/format for tables, figures (including Mermaid diagrams), and overall writing style.
